items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I've seen that happen to Jimmy Darcy... [INTERVIEWEE] now that's odd because even my limited experience we always played in all kinds of keys with the Conrad Janus band

ctx.x: I've seen that happen to Jimmy Darcy who must have had every kind of experience imaginable as a young man and playing and he couldn't get together with the Dukes of Dixon and he had any kind of keys

now that's odd because even my limited experience we always played in all kinds of keys with the Conrad Janus band just for exercise we used to deliberately change keys or transpose in the middle of tunes just to you get a very different flavor out of a tune when you play it in a different key because I can't explain how it happens but you just get a very different feeling I tell you you get in a very difficult key you start playing in D flat
